_comment: Canned NWS HeatRisk for the AZ One Health Today aggregated view. Shaped like nws-heatrisk-mcp.nws_heatrisk + nws_heatrisk_week merged. Point is Phoenix City Hall (Maricopa County) to match the agency-dashboard demo and app/heat/mock-responses.json (heat_chw_checkin, date 2026-05-19, Magenta).

category.label: Magenta
category.description: Rare and/or long-duration extreme heat with little to no overnight relief. Risk to anyone without effective cooling and/or adequate hydration.

today.advice_short: Stay indoors with AC noon-7pm. Check on neighbors over 65 or unsheltered.
